name: photo-archive-organizer
title: 家庭相册整理专家
author: 基于 6,763 张家庭照片实战整理沉淀
description_zh: 把散乱照片整理成「YYYYMM-事件名」结构化相册，支持合并共享与筛选精选两种模式
description_en: Organize messy photo collections into a structured YYYYMM-event archive, with merge-all and filter-best modes
long_description_zh: 手机、相机、微信、网盘积攒的数千张照片，文件名无意义、缺 EXIF、跨年月混杂、夹着截图票据。本技能把整理过程变成一条可复现、可校验、可回滚的流水线：五层客观信号推断日期（覆盖率 97.7%，绝不使用文件修改时间）、Ward 聚类切分事件、质量加权精选、无视觉方案的内容语义清理（用上一轮成果自标注训练判别器，AUC 0.85-0.87）、六道检验闸门、全程可回滚。已在一个真实的 6763 张家庭照片项目上完整跑通，产出 2545 张精选照片 / 100 个事件文件夹。
long_description_en: Turns thousands of unorganised photos into a structured, verifiable archive. Five-layer date inference (97.7% coverage, never uses mtime/ctime), Ward clustering into events, weighted quality ranking, vision-free semantic cleanup (self-labelled classifier, AUC 0.85-0.87), six verification gates, and full rollback. Validated end-to-end on a real 6,763-photo family archive.

examples_en: Organize my exported phone photos by year and month
Pick the best shots from thousands of photos and group them by event
